ab:
Survive one fatal attack if you have more than 40% health. It will restore some health and stamina and grants 10 seconds of immunity to all damage.
While immune, you cannot deal any damage.
Can only activate once every 5 minutes.
Only able to eat the freshest of meat, meager leftovers will not do.
Able to jump again mid-air. Only usable for the first 2 seconds after leaving the ground.

Gain 200% increased armor for 5 seconds.
Must be latched to activate.
Buff is decaying over time.

A vocal call that will make all creatures not in your group within 20 meters perform a broadcast call.
Group members also get a 20% trot speed increase for 30 seconds if they are within 100 meters.
Buff will be removed if you are in combat or enter combat.
Can eat noxious meat, fish, carrion, and bones. Who needs the 5 second rule if it's still perfectly edible?

Applies "freshly baked" to a pounced creature and increases their stamina and health recovery rates by 20% for 30 seconds. Can only be used while latched and persists after unlatching.
Effects both in and out of group players.

While latched onto another creature not in your group, reduces their armor by 10% per stack and steadily applies venom, poison and toxin.
Stacks up to 2 times.

Latch onto another creature, allowing you to perform attacks and other abilities. Release from the latch by jumping. Will automatically release when out of stamina. Deal 50% less damage while latched.
Provides three combat-based voice call abilities: Call to Maul, Call Of The Clan, and Blaring Yowl. See 'Details' for more information.
Apply a 25% attack damage increase for all group members within 30 meters for 90 seconds.
Apply a 25% armor increase for all group members within 30 meters for 90 seconds.
All enemies within 30 meters deal 25% reduced damage for 90 seconds.
Increases jump height and decreases fall damage.

30% increased bucking resistance.
While low on health, gain dramatically increased health recovery until health is healed to 25%.

A call that increases all group members armor by 25% within 50 meters.
Lasts until you are hit.
Resting or sleeping will increase your and all group members healing by 180% when within a 10 meters radius. Has no effect when in combat.

While latched onto an enemy, continuously inflicts them with 'fleas'.
Each stack of ‘fleas’ reduces health, stamina and bleeding recovery by 2.5%, and increases food and water drain by 50%, up to 10 stacks.
The latched target gains stacks faster over time.
Bleeding Heal Rate Debuff Percent Per Stack
Health Recovery Rate Debuff Percent Per Stack
Hunger Depletion Rate Debuff Percent Per Stack
Stamina Recovery Rate Debuff Percent Per Stack
Thirst Depletion Rate Debuff Percent Per Stack

Hack up a hairball in the face of all enemies within 10 meters to weaken their attack damage by 15% for 25 seconds due to disgust. Stacks up to 2 times. If enemies reach 2 stacks of hairballs on them, they will be become immune to any future hairballs for 5 minutes.
Provides three healing-based voice call abilities: Soothing Purrs, Instinctive Recovery, and Ancestral Cry. See 'Details' for more information.
Bask in the warmth of the sun to raise your healing rate by 10x for 60 seconds. Healing only activates during the day.
Purr cutely to boost the healing rate of all party members within 30 meters for 120 seconds. Must be in a group to use.
All group members within 30 meters heal status effects twice as quickly for 30 seconds. Can be used solo.
Reduces all incoming damage to yourself by 60% for 60 seconds.
Increases attack damage by 10% for all group members within 30 meters for 25 seconds.
Preened Feathers Voice Call Duration Multiplier

While latched onto another creature, reduces their ability cooldowns by 12.5% and stamina cost by 10%.
Stacks up to 4 times.
Effects ungrouped and grouped players.
Ignore uphill movement decrease, increases speed when moving downhill by 10%, and reduces falling damage by 10%.
After crouching for 10 seconds, sprint forward to gain a 50% speed boost for 10 seconds. Only usable out of combat, and will disable upon entering combat.
Provides three survival-based voice call abilities: Swift Tracks, Queens Guidance, and Enduring Hunger. See 'Details' for more information.
A call that increases your group's trotting speed by 20% for 5 minutes within 75 meters.
All group members within 75 meters receive significantly reduced damage for 2 minutes. However, affected group members will deal no damage for the duration of this buff.
All group members within 75 meters receive 30% slower food and water drain for 5 minutes.
Increase stamina recovery when not grouped. While grouped, you and each feline within 50 meters gain 10% stamina recovery. Stacks up to 4 times.
Activate for a quick forward boost of speed.
